jobs.title: Backend Engineer, Core Technology
jobs.content:
About the role

Backend engineering role on Stripe Infrastructure, responsible for reliability, scale, performance and cost of Stripe's systems. Locations: US-Remote, Chicago, Seattle, San Francisco (United States).

Requirements

  • Write high-quality code in languages such as Go, Java, or C/C++
  • 2-12+ years of professional hands-on software development experience
  • Experience with commonly used data structures and algorithms
  • Hands-on experience building large-scale distributed systems

Nice to have

  • Experience optimizing end-to-end performance of distributed systems

jobs.title: AR Analyst
jobs.content:
About the role

AR Analyst on Stripe's Finance Operations team in Bangalore, onboarding custom contracts into billing systems and supporting flux analysis.

Requirements

  • 4-5 years of financial operations or billing experience, plus a degree in Business Administration or Finance
  • Strong knowledge of G Suite, Salesforce and MS Office
  • Analyzing contracts and large data sets

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of payments and the fintech industry
